headline: Operations Leader, Live Events & Esports
profile: Live events and esports operations professional with 15 years' experience, including budget administration, invoice approval, travel and venue coordination, and vendor and freelancer management across 60+ flagship events and 300+ qualifiers in 13 countries. At BLAST, controlled tournament equipment and staffing budgets, approved invoices, arranged venues and travel for international team bootcamps, and managed freelancer bookings, contracts and payments for productions across multiple countries. Comfortable with Microsoft Word and Excel, detail-focused, and used to working to tight deadlines under pressure while handling sensitive information, including prize money and safeguarding matters. Looking to bring that administrative rigour and event logistics experience to supporting Formula 1's Event Operations team, including occasional on-site work at races.
